summary: Natural Gas Services Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of 100% of Flatrock Compression Holdings LLC. The consideration includes 241,803 shares of common stock plus $110 million in cash, subject to adjustments for cash, debt, net working capital, and transaction expenses. Sellers also receive contingent royalty payments under a separate Royalty Agreement. A $2.25 million cash escrow secures post-closing adjustments. The transaction closed simultaneously with execution on June 12, 2026. The representations and warranties do not survive closing; recourse is via representation and warranty insurance. No break fee or premium disclosed. Watch for integration execution and royalty payment triggers.
